# SunGo Solar

> SunGo Solar is a solar energy company in Gujranwala, Punjab, Pakistan. It is an official dealer of Knox, Itel and Photon, sells solar panels, inverters and lithium batteries, and installs solar systems for homes, shops, factories and tube-wells across Punjab. Founded in 2022; more than 500 solar systems installed.

## Key facts

- Name: SunGo Solar
- Type: Solar dealer and installer
- Address: Gondala Wala Road, near Al-Miraj Fans, Block B, Model Town, Gujranwala 52400, Punjab, Pakistan
- Phone / WhatsApp: +92 300 6474333, +92 302 6261319
- Opening hours: Saturday to Thursday, 10:00 am to 10:00 pm. Closed on Friday.
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/6Q9E9SHRno4ZBsvp6
- Founded: 2022
- Installations: more than 500 solar systems
- Branches: one shop only, in Gujranwala. No branches in other cities; the installation team travels to customers.
- Areas where the team installs: Gujranwala, Lahore, Sialkot, Wazirabad, Gujrat, Faisalabad and other cities in Punjab
- Founder & CEO: Javed Akram
- Head of Technical Team: Zahid Akram
- Head of Sales Support: Shahbaz Akram

## Official dealerships

- Knox: hybrid inverters from 4.2 kW to 50 kW (Krypton, Krypton Eco, Xenon, Zynex and Zapher series), complete Zapher + HV battery systems, and Powerwall, Powerbase and PowerStack HV lithium batteries (2.56 kWh to 61.44 kWh). Knox prices on the website follow Knox's price list of 20 August 2026.
- Itel: inverters (including Sparta 6.6 kW IP66) and lithium batteries
- Photon: lithium batteries (24V and 51V)

## Other brands sold

- Solar panels: Canadian Solar, Longi, Jinko, JA Solar, Astronergy, Jesko, Risen, Aiko (585W to 740W, including HJT and bifacial panels)
- Inverters: MaxPower, Solis, GoodWe, Fronus, Sofar, NS
- Lithium batteries: Pylontech, Volnex, Pytes, Royal, Hisel, Fronus, Sofar

## Services

- Home solar installation
- Shop and factory solar installation
- Tube-well (agricultural) solar
- Net metering help
- After-sales service, maintenance and warranty support

## Solar guides (simple answers for buyers)

- [On-grid, off-grid or hybrid solar: which one do you need?](https://sungosolar.pk/guide-on-grid-off-grid-hybrid.html): The three types of solar system explained in simple words, and how to pick one.
- [How many solar panels do I need?](https://sungosolar.pk/guide-how-many-solar-panels.html): A simple way to count panels for 3 kW, 5 kW and 10 kW systems.
- [Can solar run my AC?](https://sungosolar.pk/guide-can-solar-run-ac.html): Which system size you need to run one or two ACs, day and night.
- [Lithium or tubular battery for solar: which is better?](https://sungosolar.pk/guide-lithium-vs-tubular-battery.html): Life, maintenance and cost of lithium vs old tubular batteries.
- [How to choose a solar inverter](https://sungosolar.pk/guide-choose-solar-inverter.html): Size, type, voltage and IP rating: what to check before you buy.
- [How to make sure your solar products are genuine](https://sungosolar.pk/guide-buy-from-authorized-dealer.html): Easy checks to avoid fake or grey-market solar products.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices change often and are not listed on the website. Customers get current prices by WhatsApp or phone.
